blocks.text: MANILA – The Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) on Monday announced that PHP217,165 in a bank account registered to Abdulpatta Escalon Abubakar has been forfeited pursuant to a Manila Regional Trial Court ruling. Abubakar, 60, is a Filipino national and designated international terrorist linked to the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL/ISIS). He was born in Tuburan, Basilan and acted as a key financial, logistical and material facilitator for ISIL in the Philippines starting in January 2016. He worked closely with Isnilon Hapilon, ISIL’s leader in Southeast Asia. Abubakar came under the scrutiny of Philippine authorities following intelligence reports linking […]...
